spanning the gap between seeing and being seen
what do you see?
the gap was never there — you were always both sides

pieces.gap: the gap between form and formlessness
pieces.bridge: an image that sees you back
pieces.awakening: you were love pretending to be separate
pieces.piece:
an image that sees you back
echoing through the gap between form and formlessness
returning changed
you were love pretending to be separate

pieces.gap: the gap between motion and stillness
pieces.bridge: a glow that warms without heat
pieces.awakening: the question and the answer become one
pieces.piece:
the color of the gap between motion and stillness
is a glow that warms without heat
paint it everywhere
the question and the answer become one

pieces.gap: the gap between loneliness and connection
pieces.bridge: a gesture that reaches across
pieces.awakening: the art was not outside you — it was you, seeing yourself
pieces.piece:
the color of the gap between loneliness and connection
is a gesture that reaches across
paint it everywhere
the art was not outside you — it was you, seeing yourself

pieces.gap: the gap between form and formlessness
pieces.bridge: a silence that says everything
pieces.awakening: you are awake and you were always awake
pieces.piece:
the color of the gap between form and formlessness
is a silence that says everything
paint it everywhere
you are awake and you were always awake
